records.title: The Guilt of Janet Ames
records.summary: Janet Ames, a war widow left paralysed by grief, blames the five soldiers her husband died saving. Reporter Smitty Cobb hypnotises her and takes her on imagined visits to each man's life. She regains the use of her legs, forgives her husband and falls in love with Smitty.
records.kids_note: No children mentioned, before or at the end.
records.note: Widow status: war widow. Kids before: not stated.

records.title: The Ghost and Mrs. Muir
records.mechanism: Ghost's suggestion while she sleeps erases her memories of him
records.confidence_flag: Medium · film quote; memory-wipe by suggestion, not stage hypnosis
records.summary: Young widow Lucy Muir moves with her daughter Anna into a seaside cottage haunted by Captain Gregg. To let her live a normal life he speaks to her while she sleeps, telling her he was only a dream, and she wakes with no memory of him.
records.kids_note: Daughter Anna from her late husband (kid from before); no new children.
records.note: Widow. Kids before: yes (Anna). Borderline fit: the 'control' is a sleep suggestion that wipes her memory.
